text:
The `chat-sent` proposal is clear, so I made no edits. The title states the goal and the five asks are numbered. The fence and the landing steps are short.

`text-check` flagged one file, `past-work.md`, which is 855 words of prose against a limit of 500. It is agent scratch, not something the proposal or the owner reads, so I left it. I appended the "clear" line to `flags.jsonl`.
